verses: Yeh log kiss cheez kay baray mein pooch gooch ker rahey hain
Uss bari khabar kay mutalliq
Jiss kay baray mein yeh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain
Yaqeenan yeh abhi jaan len gay
Phir bil-yaqeen unhen boht jald maloom ho jaye ga
Kiya hum ney zamin ko farash nahi banaya?
Aur paharon ko mikhein(nahi (nahi banaya?)
Aur hum ney tumhen jora jora peda kiya
Aur hum ney tumhari neend ko aaram ka sabab banaya
Aur raat ko hum ney pardah banaya
Aur din ko hum ney waqt rozgar banaya
Aur tumharay upper hum ney saat mazboot aasman banaye
Aur aik chamakta hua roshan chiragh (sooraj) peda kiya
Aur badlon say hum ney ba-kasrat bhyta hua pani barsaya
Takay uss say anaj aur sabza ugaein
Aur ghanay baagh (bhi ugaein)
Be-shak faisla kay din ka waqt muqarrar hai
Jiss din kay soor mein phonka jaye ga. Phir tum foj dar foj chalay aao gay
Aur aasman khol diya jaye ga to uss mein darwazay darwazay ho jayen gay
Aur pahar chalaye jayen gay pus woh sarab ho jayen gay
Be-shak dozakh ghaat mein hai
Sirkashon ka thikana o hi hai
Uss mein woh muddaton tak paray rahen gay
Na kabhi uss mein khunki ka maza chakhen gay, na pani ka
Siwaye garum pani aur (behti) peep kay
(unn ko) poora poora badla milay ga
Unhen to hisab ki tawaqqa hi na thi
Aur bey baki say humari aayaton ki takzeeb kertay thay
Hum ney her aik cheez ko likh ker shumar ker rakha hai
Abb tum (apney kiye ka) maza chakho hum tumhara azab hi barhatay rahen gay
Yaqeenan perhezgar logon kay liye kaamyabi hai
Baghaat hain aur angoor hain
Aur no-jawan kunwari hum umar aurten hain
Aur chalkty huye jam sharab hain
O haan na to woh byhoda baaten sunen gay aur na jhooti baaten sunen gay
(unn ko) teray rab ki taraf say (unn kay nek aemaal ka) badla milay ga jo kafi inam hoga

(uss rab ki taraf say milay ga jo kay) aasmano ka aur zamin ka aur jo kuch unn kay darmiyan hai unn ka perwerdigar hai aur bari bakhsish kerney wala hai. Kissi ko uss say baat cheet kerney ka ikhtiyar nahi hoga
Jiss din rooh aur farishtay safein bandh ker kharay hun gay to koi kalaam na ker sakay ga magar jissay rehman ijazat dey dey aur woh theek baat zaban say nikalay
Yeh din haq hai abb jo chahaye apney rab kay pass (nek aemaal ker kay) thikana bana
Hum ney tumhen unqareeb aaney walay azab say dara diya (aur chokanna ker diya) hai. Jiss din insan apney hathon ki kamaee ko dekh ley ga aur kafir kahey ga kay kaash! mein mitti ho jata
